title: Apigenin enhances Nrf2-induced chaperone-mediated autophagy and mitigates alpha-synuclein pathology: Implications for Parkinson's disease therapy.
authors: Huang, Yi-Bin; Tian, Lu-Lu; Zhu, Zi-Wen; Zhou, Kai-Ge; Lai, Xue; Peng, Yan-Zi; Wu, Zhuang; Tong, Wei-Fang; Wang, Huan; Wang, Xi-Jin; Guan, Qiang; Jin, Ling-Jing; Feng, Ya; Weng, Wei-Yu; Zhang, Jing-Xing
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接筛选天然化合物芹菜素，研究其通过Nrf2介导的分子伴侣自噬清除α-突触核蛋白的帕金森病机制，虽含分子对接但核心是细胞自噬与神经保护，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The aggregation of alpha-synuclein (SNCA) in dopaminergic neurons of the substantia nigra is a key factor in the pathogenesis of Parkinson's disease (PD). Despite years of drug discovery efforts targeting SNCA aggregation, no disease-modifying drugs have been approved to date. The failure of numerous clinical trials can be attributed, at least in part, to the difficulty in identifying potent compounds during preclinical investigations. OBJECTIVE: Establish a screening approach based on molecular docking and autophagic flux detection to identify natural compounds from new perspectives of SNCA clearance and to explore its mechanism. METHODS: Molecular docking technique combined with autophagic flux detection was performed for preliminary screening of flavonoids in PubChem and CHEBI databases. Western blotting was utilized to detect the levels of SNCA, chaperone-mediated autophagy (CMA)-associated proteins, apoptosis-related proteins, and neuroinflammatory biomarkers, alongside the assessment of phosphorylation status of proteins implicated in signaling cascades. JC-1 staining was used to measure the mitochondrial transmembrane potential (MMP). RNA-sequencing and Kyoto encyclopedia of genes and genomes/gene ontology (KEGG/GO) analysis were optimized to detect gene expression. PD mouse motor function was assessed using rotarod, pole, open field, footprint, and gait analyses. Immunofluorescence staining was employed to detect the expression of Nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2), dopaminergic neuronal deficits, microglia activation, and production of inflammatory factors. LysoTracker Red staining and pSIN-PAmCherry-KFERQ-NE plasmid were used to evaluate the lysosomal activity. pHrodo Green E.coli BioParticles were employed to measure phagocytosis activity. RESULTS: By molecular docking and autophagic flux detection, we evaluated the efficacy of flavone derivatives and identified apigenin (AP) as a candidate that activates CMA to promote SNCA clearance and thereby inhibits SNCA-induced neurotoxicity. AP inhibited apoptosis by promoting SNCA degradation through Nrf2-mediated CMA activation. Moreover, AP could also inhibit apoptosis via the Nrf2/extracellular regulated protein kinases (ERK) feedback loop that operates independently of CMA activation. Additionally, AP enhanced the phagocytosis capabilities of BV2 cells and inhibited SNCA-induced neuroinflammation, both in vitro and in vivo. CONCLUSIONS: AP activates CMA to promote the clearance of SNCA, thereby inhibiting SNCA-induced neurotoxicity. Nrf2 and its role in AP-mediated neuroprotection may provide new insights that target degradation pathways to counteract SNCA pathology in PD.
abstract_zh: 背景：α-突触核蛋白（SNCA）在黑质多巴胺能神经元中的聚集是帕金森病（PD）发病机制中的关键因素。尽管多年来针对SNCA聚集的药物发现工作不断推进，但至今尚无疾病修饰药物获批。众多临床试验的失败至少部分归因于临床前研究中难以识别有效化合物。目的：建立一种基于分子对接和自噬流检测的筛选方法，从SNCA清除的新视角识别天然化合物，并探讨其机制。方法：采用分子对接技术结合自噬流检测，对PubChem和CHEBI数据库中的黄酮类化合物进行初步筛选。利用Western blotting检测SNCA、分子伴侣介导的自噬（CMA）相关蛋白、凋亡相关蛋白和神经炎症生物标志物的水平，同时评估信号级联中蛋白质的磷酸化状态。JC-1染色用于测量线粒体跨膜电位（MMP）。RNA测序及京都基因与基因组百科全书/基因本体论（KEGG/GO）分析用于优化检测基因表达。通过转棒、爬杆、旷场、足迹和步态分析评估PD小鼠运动功能。免疫荧光染色用于检测核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）表达、多巴胺能神经元缺失、小胶质细胞激活及炎症因子产生。LysoTracker Red染色和pSIN-PAmCherry-KFERQ-NE质粒用于评估溶酶体活性。pHrodo Green E.coli BioParticles用于测量吞噬活性。结果：通过分子对接和自噬流检测，我们评估了黄酮衍生物的功效，并鉴定出芹菜素（AP）为候选化合物，其激活CMA以促进SNCA清除，从而抑制SNCA诱导的神经毒性。AP通过Nrf2介导的CMA激活促进SNCA降解，进而抑制凋亡。此外，AP还能通过独立于CMA激活的Nrf2/细胞外调节蛋白激酶（ERK）反馈回路抑制凋亡。同时，AP在体外和体内均增强了BV2细胞的吞噬能力，并抑制了SNCA诱导的神经炎症。结论：AP激活CMA以促进SNCA清除，从而抑制SNCA诱导的神经毒性。Nrf2及其在AP介导的神经保护中的作用可能为靶向降解途径以对抗PD中的SNCA病理提供新见解。
